## What changes

## How you tested it

- [ ] `npm run smoke` passes
- [ ] Tried in: Chrome / Safari / Firefox / a phone
- [ ] If pictures changed: ran `npm run images` and checked the new files by eye

## Before merging

- [ ] No secrets or personal data in the diff, and no picture shows a person, a readable name tag, an address or a QR code
- [ ] README and NOTICE match the change
- [ ] New dependencies are licensed and credited
